Instructions: One lead per listed hole/contact. Verify unpowered continuity before applying power.
SDMMC CMD is GPIO47 on the breadboard and Adafruit 4682 JP1.5. Select breadboard-sd-only-2ch or breadboard-record-2ch; the PCB image uses GPIO38.
SDMMC CLK is GPIO39 to Adafruit 4682 JP1.3. This is not SPI SD wiring. Keep the card supply stable and audit the original saved file.
SDMMC D0 is GPIO40 to Adafruit 4682 JP1.4. Use all five listed SD contacts, including GND. A wireless preview cannot establish SD persistence.
microSD return lead; verified JP1 pad 2 belongs to GND in Adafruit SDIO microSD board CAD. Install with power off.
